claim: simulation cadence moved from 250ms to 50ms with vanilla game-tick values throughout; real-time durations and intervals are unchanged; projectile motion now matches the vanilla coefficients, which changes trajectories
automatic: every duration and interval derived in slices 05-12 became its vanilla game-tick value with no further constant changes
manual_additions: effect stored durations set to vanilla game ticks (totem 900/100/800, foods 2400/100/400/6000/600/300/1200)
effect periods derived as server_ticks(50/25/40) >> amp; the old code used half the vanilla game-tick period
the effect wire conversion disappeared because GAME_TICKS_PER_TICK is 1
motion coefficients replaced with javap-verified vanilla values: arrow 0.99/-0.05, throwable 0.99/-0.03
results_changed: projectile and mob trajectories, because gravity-lite approximations became the vanilla coefficients
results_preserved: furnace cook, fuel burn, air supply, weather length, autosave, TNT fuse, drop and xp lifespan, pickup delay, environmental damage intervals, crop growth rate, keepalive, time notification
ttl_decision: arrow 240, pearl 50, mob arrow 160 and bobber bite were kept at their current real time rather than removed. Vanilla has no flying TTL and 1200 is an in-ground despawn counter, so removal would change results and risk entity accumulation. Deferred to a separate slice.
reference_fix: the frozen v2.37 reference in furnace_cache_tests hardcoded progress >= 40; it now uses server_ticks(200). Without this it compared against a stale 4TPS model.
measurement: same fixtures, runner and release build, 3 processes each. Per-tick median 1.27->1.17us empty, 22.74->20.28us active furnaces, 183.11->182.35us dense actors. Whole-process CPU 0.2811s -> 0.2766s, peak RSS 14768-14860 -> 14764-14860 KiB.
measurement_limit: per tick, not per second. 20TPS runs five times as often, so CPU per second at equal load is about five times higher. This is not a lightweight-performance win and must not be claimed as one.
tests: 30 passed, 0 failed, 1 explicitly ignored, serial and at 8 threads
review: NOT RUN. codex review blocked by an external usage limit for seven consecutive slices. This is a large change committed without independent review.
open_items: legacy MET3 drop age is in milliseconds and now misread as ticks; TTLs deferred; hurt invulnerability still 500ms versus vanilla invulnerableTime 20; weather range still pinned to the lower bound; mob air not persisted; the vanilla 0.8f in-water drag branch is unimplemented
provenance_note: results.json was captured on the cutover sources. These differ from the committed sources: ['src/furnace_cache_tests.rs', 'src/main.rs', 'src/persistence_tests.rs']. furnace_cache_tests.rs differs by a trailing-whitespace fix; main.rs and persistence_tests.rs differ because the MET4 marker fix shipped in the same commit. The per-tick measurement itself was taken on the cutover cadence and remains valid; those hashes are stale.
